prompt: In one sentence, explain why a cache can speed up repeated computation.

A small team is evaluating an inference server for internal use. Describe how it should handle model startup, health checks, streamed responses, and timing measurements before adding support for concurrent requests.

Review this proposed LLM inference benchmark. It uses one model and one GPU, sends prompts from a small corpus with varied lengths, warms up the server, repeats each request several times, and reports time to first token, inter-token latency, total response time, output tokens per second, and peak device memory. Explain what conclusions these measurements support, which workload details must be recorded for the results to be reproducible, and what limitations remain before claiming production capacity. Distinguish single-request latency from multi-user throughput and identify likely sources of measurement noise.
